name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+9

- TV app: Stremio-style player (stage 4) and no debrid "other" row
  - New controls over the video: seek bar (Left/Right move a target that grows the longer you hold, then jumps), time, clock and "ends at", and a button row: play/pause, Next episode, Subtitles, Audio, Streams, Episodes. Up/Down bring the buttons up, OK pauses, Back closes a menu or leaves.
  - Subtitles menu in three columns: language | choices | settings (delay in 0.25 s steps, size, reset). Subtitles in your last language turn on by themselves (inside the video first, then subtitle files); audio language is remembered too.
  - Streams menu: switch to another stream of the same episode at the same spot (subtitle file and delay kept), or pick one for another episode.
  - Episodes menu: seasons | episodes; picking one lists its streams.
  - Subtitles move up above the controls while they are showing.
  - Play on TV from the phone keeps its Source button for the phone's servers.
  - Home leaves out catalogs of type "other" (RealDebrid Downloads).
